[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name=Morostav Trail | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=205 }} [[Morostav Trail]] is a section of the [[Echovald Forest]] that borders [[the Jade Sea]], close to the spot where the [[Jade Wind]] originated. As with other parts of the petrified forest, it is populated primarily by the [[Warden]]s, although there's a smattering of the [[Dredge]] as well as other wildlife. ==Getting there== The [[primary quest]] [[Into the Whirlpool]] will lead through here on the way to the next [[mission outpost]]. This [[explorable area]] lies between [[Durheim Archives]], [[Vasburg Armory]], and [[Unwaking Waters (Kurzick)]]. ==Shrines== ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s with [[bounty|bounties]]: *[[Kurzick Priest]] → [[Attack]]s by the foe or [[party]] members will be obstructed from any direction, preventing damage from any skill that requires a [[line of sight]]. This may prevent an unprepared party from vanquishing the area.}} ==Trivia== * This area is one of three in Factions (the others being [[Silent Surf]] and [[Mourning Veil Falls]]) where nine or more [[elite skill]]s can be captured. {{Explorable areas in the Echovald Forest}} [[de:Morostovweg]]
